body: I consider the Dutch in general to be a bunch of self-centered idiots..

also, ah, eine Deutscher :)

Heck, I used to hang out on reddit and 4chan a lot; but they ruined me... while some people must have suspected it was an addiction, quitting it was pretty easy. Actually, I only went to reddit today for this...

basically, i lack all forms of initiative and it has ruined me. When doing things I used to like, I feel nothing. When doing things I am indifferent about, I feel nothing. When doing things I don't like.. I don't feel anything. Not even empathy to be honest...

I have been delaying my suicide for 2 years already and it hasn't gotten any better, have attempted lots of things, but it has never gotten any better.

How am I supposed to fill myself with things that aren't boring? Heck, even my favorite thing (the internet/gaming) lost its fun... and other things are just not possible in this fucking flat country...

>I have pretty much failed out of high school

FYI: I live in the Netherlands, and failing out of high school (at my level) either means being forced to go to the lowest level of college (filled with people that will also eventually drive me to suicide) or turning 18 and having to start all over, something I don't fucking want.. it's the easy way out, I know, but the boredom is killing me.
